Bio.description: Enthusiastic and results-driven Software Developer with 3 years of hands-on experience in backend development, API design, AI research, and database management. Passionate about delivering scalable and efficient solutions to the stakeholders.
Bio.name: Doan Huu Nguyen

bullets: Architected a comprehensive insurance management ecosystem for AXA France, delivering a modular frontend and high-performance backend that streamlined the end-to-end policy lifecycle—from initial risk assessment to final contract issuance.
Designed and implemented scalable system architecture and data models aligned with business requirements.
Built dynamic UI components and backend logic using Django to support complex workflows.
Developed and integrated serverless functions using AWS Lambda to handle business logic and automation processes.
Ensured code quality through testing, debugging, and optimization of existing features.
keyAccomplishments: Successfully delivered multiple insurance web platforms used for quotation and client management.
Designed and implemented reusable components and logic that improved development efficiency across projects.
Contributed to improving system reliability and user experience through continuous enhancements and bug fixes, delivered 70% of the tasks on time through Jira.
Engineered and optimized a hybrid database strategy using MongoDB and relational models; refactored query structures and indexing to maintain sub-second response times as data volume upscaled by 35%.

bullets: Developed a multi-purpose, SEO-friendly online news platform with a content management system using TypeScript, React, and the Bun runtime, enabling efficient content publishing and management.
Designed a scalable relational database architecture for the news platform, ensuring data integrity and performance, and containerized the system setup using Docker for reliable deployment.
Consulted with stakeholders on the business plan and provided technical guidance to the development team, aligning the solution with the project requirements and ensuring seamless collaboration.
Developed and maintained backend services, ensuring seamless integration with frontend applications.
Built RESTful APIs with ExpressJS to handle authentication, transactions, and user interactions.
Implemented automated testing using Jest and Jasmine.
Managed server infrastructure, optimizing uptime and security.
keyAccomplishments: Led a database restructuring initiative that improved system scalability.
Improved the response time of the web application by 30%.
Mentored junior developers on best coding practices.
